propositions: Deprecated 'Success Criteria' vocabulary must be removed from live prose and replaced with 'Acceptance Criteria' in completion.py, test_completion_verifier.py, and sample-ticket-log.jsonl.

A count-pinned allowlist with path, count, and reason fields must guard against reintroduction of the deprecated vocabulary while preserving deliberate frozen migration evidence and permanent carve-outs.

The guard must enforce case-insensitive phrase matching and scoped bare-token matching (SC/SCs only in reviewer, guides, and routing paths) with deterministic failure on count drift, malformed entries, or unallowlisted matches.
The root Makefile lint target must invoke the guard so local and CI checks are identical and fail on injected deprecated vocabulary.
All O-RAN-SC sites and minified vendor assets must remain byte-identical and outside the guard scope.
The migrated repository must pass the guard with zero non-allowlisted matches, full test suite, and no reintroduction of deprecated vocabulary.
